update.title: Fixed window preview format negotiation
update.summary: Advertised explicit shared-memory and linear DMA-BUF formats so the compositor and capture client can agree on a frame buffer before copying a window preview.

blocks.body:
## Advertise compatible capture formats

The capture source tells image-copy clients exactly which buffers it can provide: ARGB8888 or XRGB8888 through shared memory, or the same formats through DMA-BUF with a linear modifier. This gives the compositor and client a common format before the first frame is copied, restoring reliable window previews while preserving the GPU path when available.

blocks.code:
SHM      ARGB8888, XRGB8888
DMA-BUF  ARGB8888 + LINEAR, XRGB8888 + LINEAR
blocks.description: Capture clients choose from the formats the source explicitly supports.
